{{Wireless adapter |brand=Egoman |model=DW220XWXX |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=06/03/2014 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=large dongle |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=2ACC2DW220 |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM43143 |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This is a large Wi-Fi dongle + USB 2.0 2-port hub combo device. It's branded to be targeted towards usage with the [[RPF Raspberry Pi Model A|'''Raspberry Pi''']] in the FCC photos ('''Egoman''' manufactures the Pi for Chinese and Taiwanese distribution).
The FCC manual seems to indicate it's using BCM43143 (brcmfmac supported..).
The hub IC may be from '''Genesys Logic'''..
